name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 2 Intermediate — Ring of Fire

system.duration: Rest of the scene or until released
system.activation: Spending a Willpower Trait, you ignite a ten-foot circle of hellish flame around yourself that persists until the scene ends, you are knocked out, or you release it. Anyone standing on the perimeter when it erupts must win a Static Physical Challenge against five Traits or take a level of aggravated damage, and anyone later trying to cross it must win a Courage Virtue Test against three Traits or take a level of aggravated damage; you alone may cross freely, though you still take damage from the flame.
